lines.text: What if a whole boarding house fit on one screen?
This is the Fe Galang Da Silva Boarding House, in Legazpi City.
Her income and expenses lived in a spreadsheet, on one USB drive.
Invoices, in a paper book. Repairs, lost in a chat. Inquiries, with no record at all.
Her ledger, in her own layout, adding itself up.
Tenants see their rent, and pay with GCash.
Repairs are tracked, from request to done.
Visitors ask about a vacant room. No account needed.
And it installs like an app.
Nine hundred thirty-seven of her real records, carried over.
Quality, rated four point five three, out of five.
Hivelet. Her whole boarding house, on one screen.
